newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: EDP opens 3,500 esc vs privatisation price 2,250.
newsitem.headline: EDP opens 3,500 esc vs privatisation price 2,250.

text.p: Shares in partially privatised utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal opened at 3,500 escudos, compared with a privatisation price of 2,250 escudos.
Later EDP eased to 3,000 escudos, up 750 from the privatisation price, in volume of 1,000 at 1007 GMT.
The minimum price traded was 2,700 escudos.
Bourse officials said 101.512 million EDP shares from Monday's public offer to sell (OPV) and direct sale were admitted to Lisbon bourse, but not shares from the green shoe.
The government earned over $2 billion in the heavily oversubscribed privatisation of 30 percent of EDP's capital.
